title: Continuous-coefficient trace data on the small pro-etale model
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and p:V→S a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Transport the continuous rational and integral coefficient ring sheaves and the valuation-ring inclusion to the existing equivalent small pro-etale model [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. The coefficient map along p is projection precomposition [def-sfb-continuous-coefficient-pullback-maps]; use the associated canonical module pullback and pushforward [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. A finite splitting over U→S consists of maps q_j:U→V over S whose maps (id,q_j):U→U×_S V exhibit a coproduct, each q_j etale. Define sheet objects, sheet restrictions, and sheet units by the actual module adjunction unit. Define the trace local-sum predicate, local image representatives by covering sieves, and local sums of integral sheet submodules by the same covering-sieve condition. Empty index types and covering sieves are allowed. These are precisely the existing definitions of the trace-image item, relocated without changing any signatures or bodies.
